title: framework/kernel.yaml: the paths the kernel owns and the protected set

protected.description: What only forge.extend may change, and the names it reserves. The kit refuses a map without this block (nothing is then writable and no name is free). `paths`: kit folders. `mode`, `connector`: names of protected instances, wherever their folder sits. `env`: protected envs; `modes` lists the unprotected modes that may put roles there (`*` = every one).

items.description: A kit-relative folder: no leading or trailing '/', no '..'.

owns.description: The paths the boundary check treats as core (globs; a trailing / owns everything below).
